title: Sparkly camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe680' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M18 20 L18 32 M12 26 L24 26'/>
    <path d='M82 14 L82 24 M77 19 L87 19'/>
    <path d='M86 72 L86 82 M81 77 L91 77' stroke='#ffd23f'/>
    <path d='M14 66 L14 76 M9 71 L19 71' stroke='#ffd23f'/>
    <path d='M50 8 L50 14 M47 11 L53 11' stroke='#fff2a8'/>
    <path d='M50 88 L50 94 M47 91 L53 91' stroke='#fff2a8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='84' r='2.5' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='48' r='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='44' r='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- camera body -->
  <rect x='22' y='36' width='56' height='38' rx='7' fill='#2f6fb5'/>
  <rect x='22' y='36' width='56' height='12' rx='7' fill='#4a8fe0'/>
  <!-- viewfinder hump -->
  <rect x='36' y='26' width='18' height='10' rx='3' fill='#2f6fb5'/>
  <rect x='38' y='28' width='14' height='6' rx='2' fill='#7fc4ff'/>
  <!-- lens outer -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='16' fill='#1d4f8a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='14' fill='#3d7fd0'/>
  <!-- lens inner -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='9' fill='#0f2f57'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='9' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='5.5' fill='#7fc4ff'/>
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='54' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- flash -->
  <rect x='64' y='20' width='12' height='10' rx='2.5' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <rect x='66' y='22' width='8' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#fff2a8'/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <rect x='26' y='28' width='8' height='9' rx='2.5' fill='#ff7a59'/>
  <!-- lens rim highlight -->
  <path d='M40 48 Q50 42 60 48' stroke='#9fd6ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
